name: GDPR Essentials
description: High-signal GDPR articles mapped to actionable controls for MVP assessments.

controls.name: Principles of Processing
controls.description: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly, transparently, limited to purpose, accurate, minimized, securely stored, and not kept longer than necessary.

controls.name: Lawfulness of Processing
controls.description: Controllers must identify and document at least one legal basis before processing begins and retain accountability evidence.

controls.name: Conditions for Consent
controls.description: Where consent is the basis for processing it must be freely given, informed, specific, granular, documented, withdrawable at any time, and evidenced.

controls.name: Transparent Communication
controls.description: Information provided to data subjects must be concise, understandable, transparent, accessible, delivered in timely fashion, generally free.

controls.name: Information Provided at Collection
controls.description: At collection, controllers disclose identity/contact, purposes/legal basis, recipients, retention, rights, safeguards for transfers and whether automated profiling exists.

controls.name: Information Provided When Data Not Obtained Directly
controls.description: When data collected indirectly controllers must proactively inform subjects with required disclosures within a reasonable period unless exceptions strictly apply.

controls.name: Right of Access
controls.description: Controllers must honour access requests confirming processing, granting copies, describing purposes, recipients, retention, safeguards, sources, profiling logic.

controls.name: Right to Rectification
controls.description: Inaccurate data must be corrected without undue delay; incomplete personal data completed when purpose requires completeness.

controls.name: Right to Erasure
controls.description: Erasure honoured without undue delay when grounds arise; documentation of exemptions, cascading instructions to subprocessors/third parties mandatory.

controls.name: Right to Restriction
controls.description: Processing must be halted or marked restricted pending disputes, wrongful processing claims, portability requests, objections; restrictions communicated downstream.

controls.name: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: Where lawful basis contractual/consent controllers provide structured commonly used machine readable data and transmit to controllers when technically feasible.

controls.name: Right to Object
controls.description: Controllers must uphold objections to profiling/direct marketing/processes unless compelling legitimate grounds demonstrated and documented outweighing impacts.

controls.name: Data Protection by Design and Default
controls.description: Implement appropriate technical organisational measures proactively minimising processed data exposing only necessity default settings aligning with GDPR.

controls.name: Joint Controllers
controls.description: Joint controllers must transparently define responsibilities and provide single contact point respecting data subject simplicity without shifting accountability.

controls.name: Processor Agreements
controls.description: Written contracts binding processors on instructions confidentiality security subprocessors breaches assistance deletion portability audits necessary measures.

controls.name: Records of Processing
controls.description: Maintain internal records documenting purposes categories recipients transfers safeguards retention DPIA summaries cross-border safeguards unless exemptions extremely narrow.

controls.name: Security of Processing
controls.description: State of art safeguards including pseudonymisation encryption resilience continuous testing confidentiality integrity availability incident capable policies.

controls.name: Breach Notification to Authority
controls.description: Personal data breaches must be communicated to supervisory authority within 72 hours unless unlikely to risk documenting records for individuals when high risk persists.

controls.name: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Where processing creates high risks controllers evaluate necessity proportionality safeguards mitigations consult supervisory authority escalation path.

controls.name: Restrictions on Cross-Border Transfers
controls.description: Transfers outside EEA rely on adequate decisions SCCs UK IDTA binding corporate rules safeguards ensuring enforceable obligations equivalent protection.
